Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Grants Woodland Creation Grants AI EWCO application processing and eligibility. Countryside Stewardship woodland capital grants. Planting target tracking against 30,000 ha/yr. Land eligibility with agricultural classification. Species selection from site conditions and climate. Payment scheduling tied to planting milestones. ELMS integration for combined payments. Multi-year maintenance and compliance. Small woodland fast-track under 5 ha. Creation mapping against national strategy. Health Tree Health Surveillance AI Ash dieback national survey and impact assessment. Phytophthora ramorum and P. kernoviae tracking. Oak processionary moth surveillance zones. Emerging pest risk from trade pathway analysis. Sweet chestnut blight containment monitoring. Acute oak decline diagnosis and confirmation. Xylella fastidiosa import surveillance. Ips typographus trap network. Biosecurity compliance for timber imports. Forest Research diagnostic lab routing. Felling Felling Licence Management AI Application intake and completeness validation. Exempt felling classification (garden, nuisance, development). Restocking condition attachment and compliance. Licence refusal with reason codes and appeal. Thinning and coppicing fast-track. Community woodland felling with parish notification. Emergency felling for windblow and disease. Compliance inspection scheduling. Licence variation on ownership change. Felling returns and sales integration. Carbon Carbon Sequestration Digital MRV AI Woodland Carbon Code registration and validation. Credit issuance against verified milestones. Net zero contribution for public estate woodland. Additionality testing against baseline scenarios. Permanence monitoring via satellite. Carbon pooling for small woodland projects. Peatland-woodland integrated accounting. Registry integrity and double-count prevention. Woodland Carbon Guarantee compliance. Quarterly sequestration reporting for DEFRA. Ancient Ancient Woodland Protection AI Ancient woodland inventory (AWI) maintenance and query. Veteran tree register curation and assessment. Planning consultation response generation. ASNW boundary verification. PAWS restoration prioritisation. Irreplaceable habitat under NPPF Para 180. Buffer zone definition and enforcement. Deer management impact assessment. Indicator species monitoring. Natural England SSSI cross-referencing. Timber Timber Supply Chain Assurance AI UK timber market price data and trends. Chain of custody (FSC/PEFC) verification. Legal timber under UK Timber Regulations. Due diligence for imported timber. Origin traceability from forest to sale. Sawmill throughput and capacity forecasting. Domestic softwood from FC harvest plans. Hardwood supply chain resilience. Construction grading (BS EN 14081). Illegal logging risk for high-risk sources. Biodiversity Biodiversity Monitoring AI Habitat condition against National Vegetation Classification. Priority species surveys (red squirrel, dormouse, goshawk). Butterfly Monitoring Scheme transect integration. Breeding Bird Survey woodland plots. Biodiversity action plan targets. Native woodland expansion indicators. Deadwood habitat and veteran tree connectivity. Lichen/bryophyte assemblage indicators. Invasive species detection and response. Biodiversity net gain woodland units.
